title: Especialista Bim (Owner’s Engineer)
description:
Estamos estruturando o time do Consórcio Gerenciador (Owner’s Engineer) para um dos mais relevantes empreendimentos de infraestrutura do país. Trata-se de um projeto portuário de grande porte, com solução de engenharia inovadora e elevada complexidade técnica, envolvendo interface com operações logísticas estratégicas e alto nível de exigência em planejamento, gestão e controle.


Por que essa vaga é diferente?

Você será a referência de Engenharia Digital/BIM no ciclo completo do projeto —da concepção e definição de premissas, passando por projeto executivo, até entrega da obra — garantindo conformidade contratual e ARTESP, com interface contínua com EPC (projetista + construtora).


Modelo e local de trabalho:

  • Contratação: PJ (tempo indeterminado)
  • Reporte: Gerente de Engenharia (interface direta e contínua com EPC)
  • Regime: presencial, com home office em dias a combinar conforme programação semanal
  • Base inicial: São Paulo — Parque da Cidade (Av. das Nações Unidas, 14401)
  • Atividades presenciais em Santos ao longo de 2027 (frequência a confirmar)


Responsabilidades da posição:


Governança BIM + Conformidade ARTESP/Contrato

  • Estruturar e conduzir o PD-BIM (implementação faseada, LOD e evolução 3D/4D/5D), garantindo aderência às exigências regulatórias e revisões periódicas.
  • Garantir que os projetos sejam desenvolvidos em BIM georreferenciado (SIRGAS2000), com padrões de modelagem e informação consistentes desde o início.
  • Definir e operar o padrão de submissão, rastreabilidade e controle de versões (workflow), assegurando histórico, auditoria e governança de entregas.
  • Assegurar entregáveis em IFC/openBIM e, quando aplicável, modelo nativo editável compatível com as necessidades de validação/aprovação.


Coordenação técnica e qualidade (liderança indireta)

  • Atuar como consultor, com liderança indireta sobre o time do projetista e o CQP/certificação, garantindo consistência, completude e auditabilidade dos entregáveis.
  • Acompanhar rotinas de federation, clash detection, regras de modelagem, requisitos de informação e model checking/validação IFC, com emissão de relatórios formais para suportar revisões e aprovações.
  • Capacidade de atuar como referência técnica, com comunicação clara entre times de projeto, obra e stakeholders.


BIM para obra (4D)

  • Implantar e governar a rotina de modelo de acompanhamento de obras, garantindo atualização quinzenal alinhada ao avanço físico e aos marcos de reporte.
  • Sustentar o uso de 4D para refletir progresso, apoiar planejamento/controle e reduzir retrabalhos entre modelo e execução.
  • Garantir integração de informações do BIM com sistemas digitais quando aplicável (ex.: GIS/SISGIS), mantendo consistência entre modelo, cadastro e acompanhamento.

Captura de realidade (no EPC, gerenciada por nós)

  • Gerenciar tecnicamente (em conjunto com a construtora) a estratégia do EPC para drones, nuvem de pontos e escaneamento, assegurando qualidade dos dados, periodicidade e retroalimentação no BIM e sistemas.

Entrega final (As Built)

  • Garantir o pacote As Built, garantindo modelos atualizados, registros comparativos e evidências de atualização de cadastros e sistemas digitais dentro dos prazos definidos.


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida em BIM/Engenharia Digital para Infraestrutura (mínimo 5 anos)
  • Capacidade de estruturar governança BIM (pré-BEP;
    base em requisitos contratuais e normativas da ARTESP).
  • Vivência com open BIM/IFC, coordenação multidisciplinar e qualidade/auditoria de modelos.
  • Inglês intermediário obrigatório;
    fluente desejável (interface com EPC/fornecedores internacionais).


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC / Autodesk Docs) como CDE (desejável).
  • Familiaridade com boas práticas de gestão da informação, CDE, padronização, auditoria e rastreabilidade.


O que você ganha trabalhando aqui

  • Participação em um projeto de grande impacto regional e nacional, com solução de engenharia túnel imerso, pioneiro na América Latina.
  • Experiência única, com uso do BIM de ponta a ponta, com participantes internacionais, em um time com tomada de decisão de alto nível.


Processo e remuneração

  • Valores serão compartilhados com candidatos que avançarem para a próxima etapa.
  • Na fase seguinte, solicitaremos uma apresentação aos selecionados.

title: Warehouse Assistant- Talent Pipeline
description:
Note: We’re proactively identifying strong profiles for future openings. This position is not immediately available.



OUR MISSION

At Evernex, we believe millions of IT parts thrown away each year deserve a second life. That’s why we step in and give them a new purpose. From hospitals to banks to airports, we ensure critical systems stay operational while helping businesses reduce costs and minimize environmental impact.

With teams across the world — from Paris to Melbourne, Dubai to São Paulo, Casablanca to Kuala Lumpur — we are building a future where IT is greener, smarter, and more sustainable. How does that sound to you?

More information is available at



Why this role matters

As our Stock Keeper in Brazil , you play a key role in ensuring that our logistics operations run smoothly and efficiently.

You are responsible for managing warehouse operations, ensuring spare parts and equipment are received, stored, and dispatched accurately and on time. Your work directly supports business continuity for our customers across the region.

You will independently manage the warehouse and ensure that all logistics processes align with Evernex standards and policies.



✨ How will you make an impact?

Our Stock Keeper ensures that warehouse operations are organized, compliant, and efficient — supporting both internal teams and external partners.

You are responsible for, but not limited to:

  • Managing warehouse operations in compliance with Evernex policies and vision.
  • Overseeing receiving, storage, inventory control, and dispatch activities.
  • Monitoring stock levels and ensuring accurate inventory management.
  • Producing regular reports (IN/OUT status, dead stock, inventory accuracy, etc.).
  • Coordinating with clients, suppliers, transport companies, and internal teams.
  • Ensuring proper space management and warehouse organization.
  • Inspecting tools and equipment and overseeing general maintenance.
  • Monitoring service quality and responding to operational feedback.
  • Ensuring warehouse productivity targets are achieved.

This is an individual contributor role — no team management is involved.



What makes you a great fit

We’re looking for someone who combines operational discipline, organization, and accountability.

Ideally you:

  • Have proven experience in stock keeping or warehouse operations.
  • Understand warehouse procedures and best practices.
  • Have hands-on experience with warehouse management systems and databases.
  • Demonstrate strong organizational and reporting skills.
  • Are comfortable working independently and taking full ownership of warehouse activities.
  • Communicate effectively with suppliers, transport partners, and internal teams.
  • Speak Portuguese, English and Spanish fluently.

Certifications in Warehouse Management, Logistics, or equivalent experience are preferred.



Why You’ll Love Working Here

Join Evernex and you’ll contribute to meaningful global operations that support sustainable IT lifecycle management.

We keep things collaborative and people focused — less hierarchy, more teamwork. You’ll find trust, flexibility, and the opportunity to take ownership of your role.

And along the way, you will:

  • Work for a global leader in sustainable IT solutions.
  • Be part of a multicultural and fast-paced environment.
  • Grow through continuous learning and development opportunities.
  • Contribute to a greener and more responsible IT industry.

title: Talent Acquisition Analyst (Bilingual)
description:
The Apex Group was established in Bermuda in 2003 and is now one of the world’s largest fund administration and middle office solutions providers. Our business is unique in its ability to reach globally, service locally and provide cross-jurisdictional services. With our clients at the heart of everything we do, our hard-working team has successfully delivered on an unprecedented growth and transformation journey, and we are now represented by over circa 13,000 employees across 112 offices worldwide.


Your career with us should reflect your energy and passion. That’s why, at Apex Group, we will do more than simply ‘empower’ you. We will work to supercharge your unique skills and experience. Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry-changing realities. For our business, for clients, and for you.

Talent Acquisition Specialist (Bilingual)

Location: Sao Paulo

Description

The Talent Acquisition Analyst will join our Americas HR team and our growing Global Talent Acquisition team reporting into the Regional Lead, Talent Acquisition Americas based in Canada. This ideal candidate will be critical in identifying hiring needs and assisting in hiring top talent to Apex open opportunities. The responsibilities of this role include pro-actively sourcing passive candidates through various sources to assist in our hiring needs within Brazil and other Latin American jurisdictions. He/She will be critical in pre-assessing candidates to present to hiring managers and guiding each manager through our hiring cycle all the way to the verbal offer process. This role requires someone to be comfortable with high volume recruiting. The right candidate is someone who can change their hiring strategy often to attract top talent to our organization.


Job specification

  • Full-cycle recruiting experience, from talent sourcing and attracting candidates to interviewing and hiring great employees.
  • Experience with university graduate program hiring (ideal)
  • Collaborate with department managers on a regular basis and proactively identify future hiring needs.
  • Attracts applicants by placing job advertisements and using social media and job sites.
  • Determines applicant qualifications by interviewing applicants, analyzing responses, verifying references, and comparing qualifications to job requirements.
  • Evaluates applicants by discussing job requirements and applicant qualifications with managers and interviewing applicants on a consistent set of qualifications.
  • Act as a point of contact and build influential candidate relationships during the selection process
  • Identifies and implements efficient and effective recruiting methods and strategies based on the available role, industry standards, and the needs of the organization.
  • Collaborates with the hiring manager stakeholders, and/or other human resource staff during the offer process, identifying and recommending salary ranges, incentives, start dates, and other pertinent details.
  • Attends and participates in college job fairs and recruiting sessions.
  • Promotes the company's reputation and attractiveness as a good employment opportunity.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.


Skills Required:

  • 4+ years recruiting experience in full life-cycle environment, including management of multiple high-volume roles simultaneously for a global company.
  • Proven English skills both written and verbal.
  • Spanish fluency would also be ideal.
  • Working experience supporting hiring in multiple locations in Latin America /US/ Canada.
  • Experience recruiting in the financial sector is ideal.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred or relevant working experience with a success record on hiring both high volume and professional business hiring.
  • Proven experience working with a Linkedin Recruiter sourcing and well versed in using the tool at its full capacity.
  • Strong sourcing techniques to attract talent.
  • Experience using and tracking through a job Applicant Tracking systems (Workday preferred)
  • A strong team player who will be part of Talent Acquisition team and works well with others within the HR team as well as cross functional teams.
  • Ability to think critically to work with different types of leaders and come up with different creative solutions in finding top talent to our organization.
  • Strong communicator who is comfortable presenting recruitment statistics to business leaders.
  • Other duties as assigned by project



What you will get in return:


  • A genuinely unique opportunity to be part of an expanding large global business and assist in helping the growth of Apex in Latin America
  • Training and development opportunities


**PLEASE KINDLY SUBMIT AN ENGLISH C.V. UPON APPLYING***



Additional information:

We are an equal opportunity employer and ensure that no applicant is subject to less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, gender identity, marital status, race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, socio-economic, responsibilities for dependants, physical or mental disability. Any hiring decision are made on the basis of skills, qualifications and experiences.

title: Especialista Em Viário (Owner’s Engineer)
description:
Estamos estruturando o time do Consórcio Gerenciador (Owner’s Engineer) para um dos mais relevantes empreendimentos de infraestrutura do país. Trata-se de um projeto portuário de grande porte, com solução de engenharia inovadora e elevada complexidade técnica, envolvendo interface com operações logísticas estratégicas e alto nível de exigência em planejamento, gestão e controle.


Por que essa vaga é diferente?

Você será a referência de Viário no ciclo completo do projeto da concepção e definição de premissas, passando por projeto executivo, até entrega da obra garantindo conformidade contratual e ARTESP, com interface contínua com EPC (projetista + construtora).

Modelo e local de trabalho:

Contratação: PJ (tempo indeterminado)

Reporte: Gerente de Engenharia (interface direta e contínua com EPC)

Regime: presencial, com home office em dias a combinar conforme programação semanal

Base inicial: São Paulo — Parque da Cidade (Av. das Nações Unidas, 14401)

Atividades presenciais em Santos ao longo de 2027 (frequência a confirmar)


Responsabilidades da posição:

Premissas e soluções viárias (do zero até a entrega)

  • Ser o ponto focal técnico de Viário para os acessos urbanos e integrações do empreendimento, garantindo coerência entre premissas, alternativas, projeto executivo e obra.
  • Definir, revisar e validar critérios e padrões de projeto (geometria, velocidades, níveis de serviço, superelevação, seções típicas, drenagem associada e interfaces), considerando restrições urbanas e ambiente portuário.
  • Analisar e apoiar estudos de alternativas (traçados, interseções, dispositivos, acessos, retornos e conexões), incluindo avaliações comparativas de desempenho, construtibilidade, riscos e impactos.

Integrações e interfaces urbanas/operacionais

  • Garantir integração do viário com disciplinas correlatas: estruturas/OAEs, contenções, pavimentação, drenagem, sinalização/segurança viária, iluminação, utilidades/interferências, desapropriações e acessibilidade.
  • Coordenar requisitos para atendimento a condicionantes de tráfego (manutenção de circulação, planos de desvio, fases de obra, acesso a comunidades/operadores e logística do canteiro).
  • Atuar na compatibilização com operação de sistemas associados quando aplicável (fluxos, restrições, acessos operacionais/emergência e áreas técnicas).

Pavimentação e reabilitação viária

  • Revisar e validar soluções de pavimentação (dimensionamento, materiais, camadas, controles tecnológicos, vida útil e estratégias de manutenção), incluindo intervenções em vias existentes, reforços e recomposições.
  • Validar critérios de desempenho e durabilidade compatíveis com tráfego previsto, ambiente e restrições de execução.

Governança técnica, qualidade e conformidade (ARTESP/Contrato)

  • Conduzir revisões técnicas e validações independentes de desenhos, memoriais, especificações, quantitativos, critérios de aceitação e planos de inspeção/ensaio, garantindo rastreabilidade de decisões e atendimento aos ritos de aprovação.
  • Atuar como consultor, com liderança indireta sobre o time do projetista e o CQP/certificação, garantindo consistência, completude e auditabilidade dos entregáveis.
  • Suportar tecnicamente temas de mudança e risco: alterações de projeto, não conformidades, engenharia de valor e subsídios técnicos para pleitos/claims (sem caráter jurídico).


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida (mínimo de 5 anos) em projetos viários urbanos e/ou rodoviários, com capacidade de atuar como referência técnica (geometria, dispositivos, acessos e interseções)
  • Vivência com obras complexas e interfaces multidisciplinares (EPC, projetista, construtora, certificação/qualidade).
  • Capacidade de conduzir análises técnicas e propor soluções considerando segurança viária, construtibilidade, impactos urbanos e faseamento de obra.
  • Capacidade de revisão crítica de projetos e comunicação clara entre times de projeto, obra e stakeholders.
  • Inglês intermediário obrigatório;
    fluente desejável (interface com EPC/fornecedores internacionais).


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com planejamento e gestão de tráfego em obra (desvios, fases, manutenção de circulação e comunicação com partes interessadas).
  • Familiaridade com boas práticas de governança técnica, auditoria, rastreabilidade e gestão de interfaces.


O que você ganha trabalhando aqui

Participação em um projeto de grande impacto regional e nacional, com solução de engenharia túnel imerso, pioneiro na América Latina.

Experiência única, com atuação no viário dos acessos urbanos e integrações do empreendimento, em um ambiente portuário de alta complexidade, com participantes internacionais, em um time com tomada de decisão de alto nível.


Processo e remuneração

Valores serão compartilhados com candidatos que avançarem para a próxima etapa.

Na fase seguinte, solicitaremos uma apresentação aos selecionados.

Como se candidatar

Envie CV destacando pontos aderência aos requisitos da vaga.

title: Auxiliar Jurídico
description:
A SYSTRA é um dos principais grupos de engenharia e consultoria do mundo, especialista em transporte público e mobilidade sustentável. Com mais de 11.000 colaboradores, nossa missão é projetar soluções seguras e inovadoras que aproximem pessoas, promovam inclusão social e facilitem o acesso ao emprego, à educação e ao lazer em todo o mundo.

Há mais de 65 anos, o Grupo atua ao lado de cidades e regiões para desenvolver, modernizar e operar infraestruturas e sistemas de transporte, acompanhando todas as fases do ciclo de vida dos projetos. Estamos presentes em mais de 80 países, incluindo o Brasil, que conta com mais de 800 colaboradores.

No Brasil, nossa história começa nos anos 1960, com estudos para a modernização da rede ferroviária e as primeiras análises para implantação de metrôs. Nas décadas seguintes, participamos de projetos que viabilizaram metrôs, VLTs, BRTs e rodovias.

A SYSTRA Brasil entrega soluções completas em todas as etapas: estudos, desenvolvimento de projetos, gerenciamento e fiscalização. Hoje, também apoiamos nossos clientes e parceiros na transição digital, ecológica e energética, sempre com foco na mobilidade do futuro.

title: Redator Sênior
description:
QUEM SOMOS


Desenvolvemos soluções tecnológicas que atendem as necessidades de um mercado de produtos digitais, nossos executados projetos são focados em escalabilidade, desempenho e inovação, essencialmente para o futuro digital.


SOBRE O DESAFIO


Buscamos um Redator Sênior com alma de estrategista para construir e refinar a voz da marca em todos os pontos de contato. Sua missão será ir além do texto operacional: desenvolver narrativas poderosas que conectem a proposta de valor aos desafios do público. Você será o guardião da mensagem, garantindo clareza, consistência e impacto em todas as comunicações, do posicionamento de marca à performance de campanhas.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Desenvolver e evoluir o tom de voz da marca, criando guias e princípios para garantir consistência em todos os canais.

  • Criar conceitos e narrativas para campanhas de marketing e comunicação, traduzindo objetivos de negócio em mensagens que engajam e convertem.


  • Produzir conteúdo estratégico de alta qualidade (artigos, whitepapers, roteiros, manifestos) que posicione a operação como referência no setor.


  • Colaborar com as áreas de design, marketing e produto para criar jornadas de cliente coesas e experiências de usuário intuitivas (UX Writing).


  • Analisar a performance do conteúdo e das mensagens, utilizando dados para otimizar a comunicação e comprovar o impacto no negócio.


  • Atuar como consultor interno de comunicação, ajudando outras áreas a refinar suas mensagens e se comunicar de forma mais eficaz.

title: Business Development Representative - Brazil
description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!

CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.

Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:

CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.


Key Milestones:

  • 2016 : Launched our first product.
  • 2018 : Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019 : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020 : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021 : Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition : Won NetApp Excellerator's "Best Growth Strategy Award," CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025 : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


About the Role:

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you’ll be at the forefront of CloudSEK’s growth. You’ll identify and qualify high-quality leads, nurture relationships with potential clients, and ultimately contribute to our mission of becoming Asia’s leading cybersecurity company.

  • Relationship building: Build rapport and establish trust with prospects, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor.
  • Pipeline development: Contribute to the sales pipeline by consistently generating qualified leads and opportunities.

title: Analista De Suporte A Compras Pleno
description:
Sobre o Projeto Sucuriú


O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.


Sobre a Arauco Brasil


No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS);
painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR);
resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.


Desafio:

Garantir a execução das atividades do escopo da equipe de Suporte a Compras, como exemplo: elaboração e divulgação de políticas e procedimentos, cadastro e homologação de fornecedores, metas e indicadores de desempenho, orçamento, atendimento a auditorias, otimizando recursos, custos e assegurando a eficiência da equipe de Suprimentos e da Arauco Celulose Brasil.


Principais Atividades:


  • Manter atualizadas políticas e procedimentos da área de Suprimentos, disseminando para os envolvidos, como compradores e clientes internos, assegurando a confiabilidade dos processos em linha com os objetivos e valores da Arauco Celulose Brasil;
  • Executar o processo de homologação de fornecedores, visando garantir que os fornecedores contratados estejam alinhados aos pré-requisitos e aptos para se relacionar com a Arauco Celulose Brasil.
  • Medir e disseminar indicadores de Suprimentos, como Prazo médio de Pagamento, SLA, Saving, dentre outros, monitorando a efetividade e eficácia dos planos de ação em caso de resultado abaixo do esperado;
  • Suportar no processo orçamentário da Arauco Celulose Brasil, apoiando na definição das premissas e no acompanhamento dos resultados da área de Suprimentos
  • Apoiar no atendimento a auditorias, quaisquer que sejam, de certificadoras, contábil, etc, podendo ser ponto focal da área no atendimento aos auditores, centralizando o envio das evidências solicitadas e acompanhamento dos eventuais planos de ação.
  • Administrar os custos da Gerência Executiva de Suprimentos, realizando acompanhamento mensal do realizado vs. Orçado.
  • Garantir o andamento do processo de acesso de terceiros às unidades, assegurando que a documentação esteja completa e disponibilizada no sistema, visando o cumprimento da legislação e a política relacionada às atividades de prestadores de serviço na Arauco Celulose Brasil.
  • Cadastrar serviços e fornecedores, através das políticas definidas para a atividade e sistema, garantindo a padronização de processos do grupo Arauco Global.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Economia, Engenharias ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Gestão da Cadeia de Suprimentos, Gestão Financeira, Logística, Gestão de Projetos ou áreas afins;

  • Domínio de matemática financeira, com foco em formação de custos, fluxo de caixa e análise de viabilidade de investimentos;
  • Conhecimento emStrategic Sourcing (canais de fornecimento com otimização de custos);

title: Account Executive Senior (Canais Indiretos)
description:

Modelo de trabalho presencial (Brooklin, São Paulo/SP)

Plano de saúde (amplitude nacional) sem custo de mensalidade e coparticipação para os nossos #Simplers e até +2 dependentes legais

Compreendendo toda área de atendimento da Diretoria, em atividades eventuais/pontuais ou quando requerida pela Gerência, desde que compatíveis com a função de atendimento aos estudantes e público em geral.   • Experiência comaudiovisual.

title: Managing Director - Crypto Payment
description:
Location: Brazil (must currently reside in Brazil with valid Brazilian ID)

Language: Fluent Portuguese (mandatory), strong English preferred



Summary:

We are seeking an experienced, crypto-savvy Managing Director to lead and expand our crypto payment business in Brazil. The ideal candidate must be Brazil-based, with prior experience in crypto, deep knowledge of the local crypto/payment ecosystem, and strong relationships with key regulatory and industry stakeholders. This role is critical to supporting Brazil licensing efforts, including assisting with the DASP licence, and will work closely with the Brazil AMLO on regulatory matters.



Key Responsibilities:

  • Support the company in obtaining the DASP licence, collaborating closely with AMLO Brazil on all regulatory submissions and compliance preparations.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with the Brazilian Central Bank (BCB) and the Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM) to support licensing and ongoing regulatory engagement.
  • Expand business development opportunities through a strong local network across crypto, payments, fintech, and financial institutions.
  • Lead Brazil's business strategy and drive growth for all crypto-payment products.
  • Maintain excellent relationships with crypto industry associations such as ABCripto, ABCB, and other relevant bodies.
  • Represent the company as the senior business leader in Brazil, attending industry events, regulatory meetings, and partnership discussions.
  • Collaborate closely with global teams (product, compliance, legal, operations) to ensure commercial success and regulatory alignment.



Requirements:

  • Must currently reside in Brazil with a valid Brazilian ID.
  • Prior experience in crypto is a must.
  • 10+ years’ experience in crypto payments, payment institutions, fintech, or related financial services.
  • Strong understanding of Brazil’s crypto/payment regulatory environment, including BCB and CVM frameworks.
  • Proven track record and strong personal network with BCB, CVM, and major industry associations (ABCripto, ABCB).
  • Demonstrated ability to support licensing processes for payment or crypto-related entities in Brazil.
  • Strong business development experience, with a proven ability to grow partnerships and drive commercial expansion.
  • Fluent Portuguese;
    strong English preferred.
  • Entrepreneurial, proactive, and able to operate in a fast-paced environment.



Vision & Mission:

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Especialista Product Designer
description:
Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

  • Participar ativamente de processos de visioning, propondo futuros desejáveis para produtos e serviços.

  • Trabalhar em parceria com times multidisciplinares (produto, tecnologia e negócios) para transformar visões em soluções tangíveis.
  • Inspirar e influenciar designers de diferentes níveis, contribuindo para a evolução coletiva da equipe.

  • Capacidade de criar e comunicar conceitos inovadores de interface e experiência.
  • Domínio de princípios de UX, UI e design systems , equilibrando visão estratégica e execução de alto nível.

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

title: Especialista Em Estruturas
description:
Estamos estruturando o time do Consórcio Gerenciador (Owner’s Engineer) para um dos mais relevantes empreendimentos de infraestrutura do país. Trata-se de um projeto portuário de grande porte, com solução de engenharia inovadora e elevada complexidade técnica, envolvendo interface com operações logísticas estratégicas e alto nível de exigência em planejamento, gestão e controle.


Por que essa vaga é diferente?

Você será a referência de Estruturas no ciclo completo do projeto — da concepção e definição de premissas, passando por projeto executivo, até entrega da obra — garantindo conformidade contratual e ARTESP, com interface contínua com EPC (projetista + construtora).


Modelo e local de trabalho:

- Contratação: PJ (tempo indeterminado)

- Reporte: Gerente de Engenharia (interface direta e contínua com EPC)

- Regime: presencial, com home office em dias a combinar conforme programação semanal

- Base inicial: São Paulo — Parque da Cidade (Av. das Nações Unidas, 14401)

- Possível mudança para Santos: a partir de 2027 (data a confirmar)


Responsabilidades da posição:

>
Estruturas do Túnel Imerso + estruturas associadas

- Ser o ponto focal técnico para o desenvolvimento e a execução das estruturas (elementos imersos, portais, transições, estruturas associadas e interfaces).

- Revisar e validar premissas e critérios estruturais (Combinação de esforços, ELU/ELS, durabilidade, estanqueidade, tolerâncias e requisitos de vida útil), considerando o ambiente marítimo/estuário (agressividade, corrosão e impermeabilização)

- Garantir construtibilidade e segurança estrutural nas fases críticas: fabricação/armazenagem, transporte/flutuação, imersão/assentamento, reaterro/lastro/proteções e condições transitórias de obra (cargas temporárias, estabilidade e fases).

- Acompanhar e validar estratégias e projetos de temporários e fases construtivas que impactem as estruturas (escoramentos, formas, etapas de concretagem, içamentos/lançamentos, procedimentos de juntas/vedações e inspeções).

- Assegurar integração e coerência técnica com disciplinas correlatas (geotecnia, dragagem/hidrodinâmica, logística marítima, BIM e sistemas do túnel).


>
Acessos urbanos, contenções e OAEs

- Atuar como referência para estruturas dos acessos urbanos: pontes/viadutos , contenções e muros, passagens, estruturas em desnível, drenagens especiais e demais OAEs previstas.

- Revisar soluções e detalhamentos com foco em segurança, custo, prazo, construtibilidade e minimização de impactos urbanos (interferências, acessos, utilidades e sequenciamento).

- Garantir consistência entre projeto e execução, reduzindo retrabalho por incompatibilidades entre disciplinas e fases.

>
Governança técnica, qualidade e conformidade (ARTESP/Contrato)

- Conduzir revisões técnicas e validações independentes (memórias de cálculo, desenhos, especificações, critérios de aceitação e planos de inspeção/ensaio), garantindo rastreabilidade das decisões.

- Atuar como consultor, com liderança indireta sobre o time do projetista e o CQP/certificação , assegurando consistência, completude e auditabilidade dos entregáveis.

- Suportar tecnicamente temas de mudança e risco: alterações de projeto, não conformidades, engenharia de valor e subsídios técnicos para pleitos/claims (sem caráter jurídico).


Requisitos:

title: Production Support Analyst
description:
Role Overview:

  • We are looking for a Fixed Income & Rates Technology Specialist to work at the heart of the trading floor, partnering closely with traders and business users to ensure the stability, performance, and continuous improvement of mission-critical trading platforms.


  • This role combines Production Support , QA Testing , and L2 Engineering , offering strong exposure to Front Office environments and complex Fixed Income products. You will primarily support platforms during LATAM trading hours , while also contributing to testing, engineering, and platform enhancements outside peak support windows.


What You’ll Be Doing:

Production Support (Front Office Focus)

  • Provide hands-on support for Fixed Income trading activities, including Bonds, Swaps, and Inflation-linked instruments.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for traders and business users, owning incidents from triage to resolution.
  • Perform rapid impact analysis during live trading and drive effective workarounds to keep trading running.
  • Investigate root causes across the full trade lifecycle (capture → booking → settlement).
  • Contribute to problem management, reducing recurring incidents through long-term fixes.
  • Maintain clear documentation to strengthen the knowledge base.


QA Testing & L2 Engineering

  • Execute functional, non-functional, regression, integration, and E2E testing for Fixed Income platforms.
  • Design and manage test cases based on real trading scenarios and edge cases.
  • Identify, track, and follow up on defects using Jira , working closely with development teams.
  • Support application delivery across the full lifecycle, from testing to production readiness.
  • Depending on your background, contribute to:
  • Minor enhancements and bug fixes.
  • Monitoring and alerting solutions to proactively detect system issues.


What We’re Looking For:

✔ Front Office Support & Problem Solving

  • Strong experience supporting trading desks in time-critical environments.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with traders under pressure, translating technical issues into business terms.
  • Confident incident ownership and prioritization during live markets.


✔ Financial Markets Knowledge

  • Solid understanding of Fixed Income products : Bonds, Swaps, Futures, Credit, Govies, Inflation-linked instruments.
  • Familiarity with OTC and eTrading workflows.
  • Understanding of market data, pricing, and risk analytics (PnL, sensitivities).


✔ Testing & Validation Expertise

  • Pre-market system and market data validation.
  • Trade testing with P&L and risk verification.
  • Regression testing and UAT coordination with trading desks.


✔ Tools & Technical Awareness (Nice to Have)

  • Jira and test management tools (e.G. Xray).
  • Basic scripting (SQL, Bash, PowerShell) for data and log analysis.
  • Exposure to Python, Java, or JavaScript (reading code, understanding stack traces).
  • Log analysis using tools like Kibana.
  • Understanding of:
  • Cloud platforms (AWS: Lambda, S3, EFS).
  • Microservices and REST APIs.
  • Messaging systems (Kafka, MQ, SNS/SQS).
  • Relational and NoSQL databases.


➕ Bonus (Not Mandatory)

  • Monitoring tools (Splunk, CloudWatch, Grafana, Dynatrace).
  • CI/CD pipelines.
  • Caching technologies (Redis, Memcached).


What We Offer:

  • Work on advanced, cloud-native trading platforms.
  • Daily collaboration with global traders, quants, and engineering teams.
  • Strong learning curve with training and career development opportunities.
  • Hybrid and flexible work environment.
  • Working hours : Standard business hours (GMT-6) with on-call rotation for critical production support.

title: Data Architect (Data Modeling & Optimization)
description:
About You

You are a Data Architect with a strong focus on designing, optimizing, and scaling high-performance data solutions. You enjoy working close to the database layer and understanding how architectural decisions directly impact performance, scalability, and reliability. You are comfortable owning data architecture decisions end to end and thrive in environments where deep technical expertise, autonomy, and collaboration with engineering teams are essential.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in data architecture, database architecture, or similar roles with a strong focus on performance optimization.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating data solutions on AWS, with strong preference for RDS and Aurora.
  • Advanced expertise in SQL, including complex query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, and stored procedure development.
  • Deep understanding of how CPU, memory, storage, and I/O constraints impact database and data architecture performance.
  • Experience defining and applying architectural best practices for high availability, scalability, and performance.
  • Strong proficiency using GitHub for version control, collaboration, and documentation.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of architectural decisions, and drive improvements end to end.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data quality and system performance.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with distributed and US-based teams.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, evolve, and maintain data architectures that prioritize performance, scalability, and reliability on AWS RDS and Aurora.
  • Analyze and optimize database workloads through SQL performance tuning, query refactoring, and advanced indexing strategies.
  • Identify architectural and infrastructure-level bottlenecks related to CPU, memory, storage, and I/O, proposing scalable solutions.
  • Define and enforce data modeling and architectural standards for high-performance transactional and analytical workloads.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers and technical teams to ensure strong alignment between application and data layers.
  • Establish and promote best practices for database performance monitoring, optimization, and reliability across environments.
  • Review and optimize stored procedures and complex SQL logic from an architectural and performance perspective.
  • Document data architecture decisions, performance guidelines, and optimization strategies.
  • Act as a technical reference and advisor for data architecture and performance topics across teams.
  • Support technical discussions with stakeholders by providing clear recommendations and trade-off analyses.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Especialista De Processos
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional especialista em processos para atuar na estruturação, análise e melhoria de processos organizacionais, apoiando projetos estratégicos e operacionais para o desdobramento do mapa estratégico e para iniciativas de estrutura organizacional, promovendo a otimização de processos internos, assegurando o alinhamento dessas ações à estratégia do negócio e ao modelo de atuação de uma consultoria de inteligência antifraude.

Conheça nossa história:


A nossa história começa em 1994, na Argentina, quando a GIF se estabeleceu como fornecedora estratégica para empresas. Na mesma época, houve uma expansão comercial significativa, que foi acompanhada por um aumento de casos de fraudes. Foi nesse momento que a assumimos a responsabilidade de garantir a segurança das empresas e entramos em ação.

Ao longo desses quase 30 anos, a GIF tem trabalhado incansavelmente na prevenção, detecção e combate às fraudes corporativas. Uma história marcada por confiança, dedicação, colaboração, transparência e respeito.

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Conduzir projetos e conectar as equipes com foco no mapeamento e redesenho de processos internos em diferentes áreas da empresa (operações, tecnologia, negócios, backoffice, entre outras).
  • Mapear processos de ponta a ponta, identificando gargalos, riscos, redundâncias, oportunidades de melhoria, comunicação e entrega.
  • Propor e implementar melhorias de processos com foco em eficiência operacional, qualidade, escalabilidade e controle.
  • Apoiar a definição de papéis, responsabilidades e fluxos de decisórios.
  • Definir, acompanhar e apoiar a evolução de indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) relacionados a processos e projetos.
  • Atuar de forma consultiva junto às áreas internas e alinhamentos com as lideranças.
  • Documentar processos, políticas, procedimentos e modelos operacionais, garantindo clareza e padronização.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de transformação organizacional e crescimento da empresa, especialmente em um contexto de consultoria de inteligência antifraude.
  • Atuar como interface entre estratégia, operações e tecnologia, apoiando a melhoria contínua dos serviços da empresa.



Requisitos e qualificações


  • Graduação completa em Administração, Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia, Economia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em mapeamento e redesenho de processos, apoiados em metodologias.
  • Desejado conhecimento em metodologias: Improoving Performance – Rummler Brache, Sincronismo Organizacional e BPMN.
  • Experiência com definição e acompanhamento de indicadores de desempenho (KPIs).
  • Perfil consultivo, com capacidade de atuar em ambientes dinâmicos, lidar com múltiplos stakeholders e conduzir projetos de ponta a ponta.
  • Forte capacidade analítica, visão sistêmica e habilidades de comunicação.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de mapeamento e documentação de processos (Bizagi, Visio, Miro, Lucidchart ou similares).

  • Experiência prévia em atuação em empresas de consultoria.

title: U.S. Border Patrol Agent
description:
Border Patrol Agent (BPA) Entry LevelNEW RECRUITMENT AND RETENTION INCENTIVES!IMPORTANT NOTICE : Duty assignments available at the time of offer may include the Southwest Border, including prioritized locations.U.S. Border Patrol determines duty assignments at the time of offer based on operational needs, which may or may not align with candidates' first-choice preferences. Relocation may be required.DON'T FORGET TO CHECK OUT THE INCENTIVES - SEE SALARY SECTION BELOWThe U.S. Border Patrol (USBP) offers those interested in a career in law enforcement an opportunity to work with an elite team of highly trained professionals whose camaraderie, pride, and purpose are hallmarks of their daily mission of protecting America.If you seek an exciting and rewarding job that provides excellent pay, exceptional federal benefits, and job stability, now is the time to make your move. U.S. Border Patrol (USBP), within the U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), is hiring immediately for these full-time, entry-level, career Law Enforcement Officer (LEO) opportunities.Salary and BenefitsAnnual Base Salary for newly appointed BPAs varies per grade, as follows:GL-5/GL-7 $49,739 - $89,518 per yearDuty location impacts pay rates;
locality pay for federal law enforcement is higher in some locations than others. A fully trained BPA may be eligible for up to an additional 25% of base pay per the BPA Pay Reform Act of 2014. This is a career ladder position with a grade level progression of GL-5, GL-7, GL-9, GS-11, and GS-12. You will be eligible for a promotion to the next higher grade level (without reapplying) once you successfully complete 52 weeks in each grade level.Border Patrol Agents are eligible to select from an array of federal employment benefits that include health, dental and other insurance plans, a generous annual and sick leave program, and participation in the Thrift Savings Plan, a retirement plan akin to a traditional ROTH 401(k) offering.*Recruitment Incentive* Newly appointed Border Patrol Agents (as defined in 5 CFR 575.102 ( ) will be offered up to a $20,000 incentive. The first $10,000 will be paid upon successful completion of the Border Patrol Academy, with the remaining $10,000 awarded for accepting a prioritized location. Prioritized locations include Sierra Blanca, TX;
Presidio, TX;
Sanderson, TX;
Comstock, TX;
Lordsburg, NM;
Freer, TX;
Hebbronville, TX;
Ajo, AZ.*Retention Incentive* Newly appointed Border Patrol Agents may also qualify for up to $40,000 in additional incentives distributed over their first four years.Duties and ResponsibilitiesAs a BPA, you will be part of our 60,000+ workforce that strives to protect the American people by safeguarding our borders, deterring illicit activity, and enhancing the nation's economic prosperity. Being a BPA makes you a valuable member of the Federal Law Enforcement Officer (LEO) profession.Typical assignments include:* Detecting and questioning people suspected of violating immigration and custom laws and inspecting documents and possessions to determine citizenship or violations* Preventing and apprehending undocumented noncitizens and smugglers of noncitizens at or near the borders by maintaining surveillance from covert positions to include using infrared scopes during night operations* Interpreting and following tracks, marks, and other physical evidence of illegal entry of persons or contraband* Performing farm checks, building checks, traffic checks, city patrols, and transportation checks* Patrolling the international boundary and coastal waterways using a variety of government assets such as vehicles, horses, vessels, watercraft, off-road vehicles, ATVs, snowmobiles, and motorcycles for the accomplishment of the USBP Mission.QualificationsYou qualify for the GL-5 grade level if you possess one of the following:Experience : One (1) year of general work experience that demonstrates the ability to take charge, make sound decisions, and maintain composure in stressful situations;
to learn regulations, methods, and techniques through classroom training and/or on-the-job instruction;
and the ability to gather concise information through questioning, observation, and examination of documents and records;
OREducation Substitution : A bachelor's degree or successful completion of a full four-year course of study in any field leading to a bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university;
ORCombination of Experience and Education : A combination of general work experience AND successfully completed college education. This will be calculated using your resume and official or unofficial transcripts submitted with your application.You qualify for the GL-7 grade level if you possess one of the following:Experience : One year of specialized work experience that shows you have the skills necessary to:* Make sound judgments and decisions in the use of firearms.* Deal effectively with people in a courteous and tactful manner in connection with law enforcement matters.* Analyze information rapidly and make prompt decisions where you will be expected to make arrests after the completion of required training and apply these skills in a law enforcement capacity such as criminal code enforcement, determining violations of laws, correctional or rehabilitation work involving criminal offenders, security, military, etc.The above experience will be applied in connection with the following: Make arrests and exercise sound judgment in the use of firearms;
deal effectively with people in a courteous manner in connection with law enforcement matters;
analyze information rapidly and make prompt decisions;
or develop and maintaincontact with a network of informants.Education Substitution for the GL-7 grade level : A bachelor's degree with superior academic achievement, which is based on (1) class standing, (2) grade-point average (i.E., GPA of 3.0 or higher out of a possible 4.0), or (3) honor society membership. Or will receive a bachelor's degree with Superior Academic Achievement. Or one full year of graduate-level education in a field of study related to law enforcement (e.G., criminal justice, homeland security, justice studies, law enforcement, courts and judicial systems, forensic technology, forensic psychology, or corrections and rehabilitation) from an accredited college or university;
ORA Combination of Experience and Education : This will be calculated using your resume and official or unofficial transcripts submitted with your application.Note : If you have previous or current law enforcement or military law enforcement experience, you may qualify at the GL-9 and or GS-11 grade level. Please refer to the BPA GL-9 - 11 announcement.Other RequirementsCitizenship : You must be a U.S. Citizen to apply for this position.Residency : You must have had primary U.S. residency (includes protectorates as declared under international law) for at least three of the last five years.Age Restrictio n: In accordance with Public Law 100-238, this position is covered under law enforcement retirement provisions. Candidates must be referred for selection to the Border Patrol Agent position before reaching their 40th birthday in accordance with Department of Homeland Security Directive 251-03. The age restriction may not apply if you are currently serving or have previously served in a federal civilian law enforcement (non-military) position covered by Title 5 U.S.C. 8336(c) or Title 5 U.S.C. 8412(d).Veterans' Preference : You may also be eligible for an excepted service Veterans Recruitment Appointment (VRA). The age restriction does not apply if you are Veterans' Preference eligible.Formal Training : After you are hired, you will be detailed to the U.S. Border Patrol Academy in Artesia, New Mexico, for approximately six (6) months of intensive instruction in immigration and nationality laws, law enforcement and USBP-specific operations, driver training, physical techniques, firearms, and other courses. Border Patrol work requires the ability to speak and read Spanish, as well as English. Border Patrol Agents will be provided training to become proficient with the Spanish language at the Academy.How to Apply:Click the Apply button on this site. You will be linked to the CBP Talent Network registration page. For Position of Interest, select Border Patrol Agent, then complete the pre-screening questions.You'll then receive a link(s) to the BPA Job Opening Announcements (JOAs) on USAJOBS, the federal government's official employment site, to complete your application. Be certain to review ALL details of the job opportunity announcement and follow all instructions in the application process, including items (resume, transcripts, etc.) to submit. You will be evaluated based on your resume, supporting documents, and the BPA Entrance Exam.If you have questions about the application process, contact a recruiter through the U.S. Border Patrol page: careers.Cbp.Gov/s/usbp.As a subscriber to the CBP Talent Network, you'll receive monthly emails with information about webinars, career expos, and future opportunities with CBP.

title: Banco De Talentos Pcd
description:
Sobre a Empresa:


Na Merz Aesthetics® , acreditamos no poder da confiança. Somos uma empresa global dedicada exclusivamente à medicina estética, com mais de 115 anos de história e presença em mais de 90 países. Nosso propósito é ajudar pessoas ao redor do mundo a se verem, se sentirem e viverem como suas melhores versões.



Sobre o banco de talentos:


Cadastre seu perfil e venha fazer parte de uma empresa que acredita no poder da inclusão. Na Merz Aesthetics, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas. Valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas e estamos comprometidos com a construção de um ambiente inclusivo, respeitoso e acessível. Nossas vagas estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência, e se você se enquadra como PCD e não encontrou em nosso site de carreiras nenhuma vaga que seja do seu interesse, junte-se ao nosso banco de talentos PCD!


Importante: ao se inscrever em nosso banco de talentos PCD, você não está efetivamente se candidatando para uma posição na Merz Aesthetics e o contato se dará assim que tivermos alguma oportunidade que seja aderente ao seu perfil.

title: Internship Opportunity: Founder’s Office
description:
About the Company:

  • Axience is a professional business services firm, established with a credo of delivering “Integrated Bespoke Solutions” for our clients. Our vision is to "Impact our clients, colleagues and community with innovation, insight and empathy"
  • We provide high quality bespoke and boutique-style financial and business research services and have established ourselves as a well-regarded research firm with a strong clientele, board and management team
  • Our main offices are located in Mumbai (India) with extended sales and execution capabilities in UAE, Canada and we plan to ramp up our teams in these places and farther including South America

Position - Founder's Assistant Intern

  • Axience is seeking an Intern – Founder's Assistant based in Sao Paulo or other cities in Brazil. Position will be remote in most part except when Founder travels to Brazil. There may be potential travel opportunities within and outside Brazil for suitable profiles
  • This internship at Axience offers a unique opportunity for highly motivated students to work directly and indirectly with the Founder supporting as strategy / research / sales intern and executive assistant
  • The duration of the internship can be 6 or 12 months

Key Responsibilities

Executive Business and Personal Support

  • Understand long term and short term professional and personal priority of Founder and help him organize his agenda, activities, travels, events and meetings efficiently
  • Support in global activities in general and South American activities in particular
  • Take notes and instructions and pass it on to teams located in other geographies as we follow the sun
  • Act as the social/business concierge for Founder to understand Brazil's business, culture and community
  • Be part of centralized teams to enable our delivery and strategy function including business and executive assistants, HR, branding and marketing and other central functions

Sales and Business Development

  • Learn and follow in-depth pre-sales processes targeted at global clients focusing on global and South American markets
  • Research and map target companies and individuals, build emails lists, collect info from public sources
  • Send emails to potential existing and new targets while understanding each clients segments
  • Update / clean / maintain client databases
  • Support partner and client calls: take structured notes, capture decisions, and ensure follow-through
  • Help prepare for events and conferences and in select cases travel to attend events

Financial and Business Research and Analysis

  • Be exposed to financial and business research techniques and work on internal and clients projects
  • Support project execution related to Brazil
  • Identify consulting and financial advisory opportunities between Brazil and the world

Academic and Professional Background

  • Students currently pursuing Bachelor’s or Master’s degrees in Business, Finance, Economics, Management, Marketing, Administration, International Relations or Languages from top Brazilian or international universities or students who have recently finished their studies / early career candidates
  • Strong academic record with demonstrated analytical and communication skills

Required Skills

  • Strong communication skills and fluency in English
  • Strong analytical mindset and the ability to think critically and independently
  • Strong interpersonal skills, a proactive attitude and a pleasant personality
  • High attention to detail and with strong organizational / structuring abilities
  • High degree of professionalism, discretion, and ownership

What You’ll Gain

  • Opportunity to work directly with the Founder and leadership;
    exposure to global markets
  • Unmatched exposure and learning opportunity expected to open exciting future opportunities both at Axience and outside
  • Possibility of transition into a full-time role based on performance and business needs

Location and Duration:

  • Location: Basel (Remote)
  • Duration: 6 or 12 months and it will be a paid internship as per the local company standards


Contact

  • If you have the qualification, experience, and passion for the role mentioned above, please send your CV and Cover Letter to

title: Data & Insights Analyst
description:
At ProfitlogiQ, you will be responsible for measuring and interpreting campaign performance and organic positioning across major retail players (Amazon, Mercado Livre, Shopee, Magalu, and TikTok Shop). Your mission is to bridge the gap between raw data and strategic decision-making by designing measurement models and integrating digital analytics tools with our AI-powered solutions.

You will perform deep-dive queries, generate automated reports, and provide insights that allow for the operational exploitation of information. Your goal is to find patterns in data that produce actionable insights , enabling our clients to optimize their retail digital Ads and adapt to changing market dynamics through data-driven strategies.


Key Responsibilities
  • Measurement Strategy: Translate business requirements into robust measurement models and dashboards.
  • Actionable Insights: Design and implement projects within our measurement platforms to identify user behavior patterns across the entire consumer journey.
  • Reporting & Dashboards: Design and produce automated reports (KPIs/Metrics), ensuring data-consuming teams have documented and clear access to information.
  • Holistic Analysis: Conduct qualitative and quantitative analysis of consumer and brand behavior, covering both organic and paid (Retail Media) strategies.

  • Analytical Power: Expertise in qualitative, quantitative, and descriptive analysis.

  • Retail Media Ecosystem: General knowledge of Amazon Ads, Mercado Livre (MELI) Ads, and Google Ads/Display is highly desirable.
  • Analytics Tools: Experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and retail-specific analytics.
  • Excel Mastery: Advanced Excel skills for data cleaning and quick modeling (Pivot Tables, Power Query).
  • Strategic Thinking: Understanding of audience segmentation, market trends, and attribution models in digital analytics.


Requirements
  • Languages: Full professional proficiency in English or Spanish (mandatory for international reporting).
  • Experience: Previous experience in AdTech, E-commerce, or Digital Agencies focusing on performance data.


What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.
  • Flexible hybrid work model (São Paulo/Home Office).
  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technology in the fast-growing Retail Media sector.
  • A collaborative, international environment with real growth opportunities.

description:
About us:

Archroma is a globally recognized leader in specialty chemicals, dedicated to creating a more colorful, sustainable, and efficient world. Our mission is to be the best partner for our customers, with a strong commitment to innovation, quality, and sustainability. With a rich heritage of more than 100 years, we continue to drive excellence in the chemical industry. As we expand our operations, we are seeking a qualified and dedicated professional in the technical commercial area of Paper to join our team.


Position Overview:

The Product Stewardship Analyst supports the business product steward/Manager in the activities of the regional regulatory compliance and marketability of Archroma’s products, raw materials, and traded goods. This contract role is responsible for research, collection and validation of regulatory data as per the global Product Stewardship strategy, maintaining regulatory databases, securing product certifications, and supporting teams in achieving chemical compliance and sustainability goals.


Key Responsibilities:

- Maintain and update product safety data in SAP-EHS, sales/marketing databases and other regulatory systems.

- Documentation of hazard assessments, GHS classifications, Safety Data Sheets (SDS) and product labels for assigned countries and languages.

- Prepare registrations dossier, regulatory reporting under the supervision of business Steward.

- Compile & submit product compliance data accordingly to market & application standards.

- Secure certifications such as FDA, ecolabels, and customer-specific or brand requirements.

- Product safety data collection, validation and maintenance of company databases (e.G., SAP-EHS, The Safe Edge, Salesforce). Maintain accurate record-keeping of product safety information and customer communications.


Required Competencies:

- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Environmental Science, or a related field.

- 1-2 years of experience in product stewardship or Environment, Health, Safety department in a specialty chemical manufacturing company

- Fluency in English and Spanish is mandatory

- Quick learner with ability to work with moderate supervision and guidance Basic knowledge of Customer-focused mindset with a Can-do approach to problem-solving.

- Good analytical, organizational, and communication skills.

- Interested in chemical regulations and product standards.

- Awareness of SAP-EHS / regulatory databases preferred.

Job Title: System Administrator – Multi-OS & Office Infrastructure Management

Experience Level: 2 to 5 years

Job Location: São Paulo, Brazil


Job Summary:


We are looking for a reliable and experienced System Administrator to manage multi-OS environments and oversee small office IT infrastructure. The role involves maintaining systems, managing endpoints through MDM, handling ticketing systems, and coordinating with the central IT team to ensure seamless IT operations and compliance with organizational standards.


Key Responsibilities:


System Administration (Multi-OS)

  • Install, configure, and maintain Windows, Linux, and macOS systems.
  • Manage user accounts, permissions, and access controls.
  • Perform OS patching, upgrades, and regular system updates.
  • Monitor system performance and ensure endpoint security compliance.
  • Provide troubleshooting for hardware, software, and OS-related issues.
  • Perform routine system maintenance and health checks.

Office IT Infrastructure Management

  • Manage LAN/WAN connectivity, Wi-Fi routers, switches, and firewall devices.
  • Maintain printers, scanners, and other office IT peripherals.
  • Monitor and maintain backup systems and recovery processes.
  • Maintain IT asset inventory and documentation.
  • Coordinate with ISPs and vendors for hardware, networking, or service issues.

Ticketing System Management

  • Manage and monitor IT service requests using the organization’s ticketing system.
  • Track issue resolution timelines and ensure SLA compliance.
  • Document troubleshooting steps and maintain knowledge base articles.
  • Escalate complex issues to appropriate teams when necessary.

Mobile Device Management (MDM)

  • Enroll, configure, and manage company devices (laptops, mobile devices) via MDM solutions.
  • Enforce security policies, device compliance, and remote troubleshooting.
  • Manage software deployments and security updates through MDM tools.
  • Handle device provisioning and de-provisioning processes.

title: Senior Professional Services Engineer
description:
At Gigamon, our purpose is to protect the hybrid networks and data of the largest, most complex organizations on the planet. Certified as a Great Place to Work, we offer a deep observability pipeline that efficiently delivers network-derived intelligence to cloud, security, and observability tools. This helps our customers to eliminate security blind spots, optimize network traffic, and dramatically reduce tool cost and complexity, enabling them to better secure and manage their hybrid cloud infrastructure. Gigamon has served more than 4,000 customers worldwide, including over 80 percent of Fortune 100 enterprises, 9 of the 10 largest mobile network providers, and hundreds of governments and educational organizations.


This role focuses on post-sales deployment and optimization of Gigamon’s network visibility solutions, ensuring positive business outcomes for customers. The Professional Services Engineer will join a collaborative, innovative team with a strong emphasis on customer satisfaction, system optimization, and quality delivery. This is an individual contributor role that works closely with cross-functional teams, system architects, and end-user technical teams. The environment values technical expertise, problem-solving, and security-driven thinking. This is a hybrid role based in São Paulo (extended area), Brazil, and will occasionally require on-site support at customer locations.


What you’ll do:

  • Lead solution design, deployment, and optimization efforts for Gigamon’s network visibility and security products.
  • Work in a hybrid model based in São Paulo, Brazil, providing occasional on-site deployment, troubleshooting, and optimization support at customer locations as needed.
  • Identify deployment alternatives and propose optimized solutions for customers across various industries, including mobile networks, service providers, and enterprises.
  • Conduct testing, documentation, and pilot deliveries to ensure high-quality deployment results.
  • Work with Gigamon and customer network visibility and security teams on policy compliance efforts in line with Gigamon standards, industry privacy and security regulations, and guidelines set forth by applicable country, federal, and local laws.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage existing and prospective network visibility solutions, reviewing relevant use cases, security policies, and procedures with business stakeholders.
  • Partner closely with system architects to ensure business systems and applications meet security requirements in preparation for end‑user review, actively participating and contributing to internal Gigamon reviews.
  • Collaborate with Gigamon and end‑user technical teams to ensure developed tools, systems, and applications meet appropriate security standards, policies, and procedures.


What you’ve done:

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in the operational design and deployment of network management tools and applications in large-scale and/or virtualized networks, supporting mobile networks, service provider, enterprise, or government use cases.
  • Strong technical expertise in network protocols (TCP/IP, L2/L3, IPv4, IPv6), virtualization (VMware, Hyper‑V), and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, OpenStack).
  • Cloud certifications (e.G., AWS, Azure, GCP) are highly desirable.
  • Proficiency in programming languages (Python, Java, C) and working with APIs is a plus.
  • Proven experience leading technical initiatives without formal authority and collaborating with virtual teams across different geographies.
  • Familiarity with security frameworks and cybersecurity standards (ISO 27001/27002, CIS, NIST) is highly desirable.


Who you are:

  • Fully bilingual professional (English and Portuguese) able to hold professional conversations smoothly
  • A proactive problem-solver who thrives under pressure and can effectively communicate complex technical concepts.
  • A team player with excellent interpersonal skills who can work cross-functionally and lead without formal authority.
  • Highly analytical with a deep understanding of network security principles and compliance standards.
  • Detail-oriented, with a passion for continuous learning and staying updated on emerging technologies.
